text: opus5-24 starting: touch parity for this session's gestures. Reading the current braindump.js gesture code before designing anything.

Measured the baseline on a Pixel 5 before designing: the pen icon long-press-drag ALREADY works on touch (brush 4 -> 28 with real CDP touch), the pin handle ring does not respond to touch at all, and its handles are 12px bands / 24px corners.

Finding worth keeping: headless Chromium reports navigator.maxTouchPoints === 2 on a plain desktop context, so shouldUseTouchSelectBehavior() is true in every desktop Playwright run in this repo. Gated the new touch bar on (pointer: coarse) instead, which is also what the CSS uses.

Patch ready: 11 hunks in braindump.js, 2 in braindump.css. Touch bar with a pin action and an axis-lock latch, a visible dashed guide for any locked drag (desktop Shift too), touch on the pin handle ring, 44px handles on a coarse pointer. tests/board/touch-gesture-parity.test.mjs: red without the patch, all 6 cases green with it. pin-move-and-snap, shift-constrained-drag, alt-drag-copy-undo, pen-and-eraser-tools, mobile-pinch-zoom, board-shift-snap-runtime, pin-to-viewport, toolbar-dock-position and theme-and-light-mode all green against the patched build. Alt-drag copy is the one gesture left with no touch path; written up in notes.md.
